quota_enforcement_method: Count chat_message_sent events in mvp_analytics_event for user today
admin_actions: Adjust single user quota: increase mvp_daily_quota_per_user in env for all users (TODO: per-user override)
Reset quota: quota resets daily at midnight (no manual reset needed for day boundary)
Disable abusive user: set mvp_invite.expires_at = NOW() in DB
Close all chat: set MVp_KILL_CHAT=true in env, restart
